request: Explicit maintainer request in this chat: create a Why Eylema brochure with striking headlines; audience confirmed as general introduction and potential contributors.
deliverables: Four-page A4 Turkish brochure and English companion, editable bilingual copy, reproducible PDF builder and bounded claim/source record.

acceptance.criterion: Clear, striking introduction for general readers and potential contributors
acceptance.check: Read both language versions and inspect all eight rendered PDF pages

acceptance.criterion: Existing logo and brand colors; readable Turkish glyphs and no clipped text
acceptance.check: PDF text extraction, page bounds and visual rendering

acceptance.criterion: Current implementation and future ambitions remain distinct
acceptance.check: Compare claims with pinned core README/G08 evidence and product architecture, API and roadmap
Required local commands, translation hashes, diff and real PR body validation

roles.architect: Codex, GPT-6 family; exact model revision not exposed
roles.verifier: Same Codex context, tool-based checks and visual inspection

decisions: Use current main in an isolated worktree because the original checkout contains unrelated work.
Keep the brochure as a brand asset in core; source product architecture remains in the language repositories.
Use orange, ink and paper from the existing brand. Use vector typography and diagrams rather than invented product screenshots.
Revision 2 adds a scoped PDF binary attribute after Git interpreted ReportLab PDF streams as text; preserve PDF bytes and avoid text diffs without changing validators.
Label this as an early-development vision brochure and bind status claims to a source revision. Full task flow, GPU/model execution and autonomous development remain future acceptance work.
risks: Fast-moving implementation may outdate the status snapshot
PDF is for digital sharing and ordinary A4 printing; no press bleed or CMYK profile
No new runtime, model, GPU, performance or independent-review evidence is created by editorial checks
